description: Markov trigger sequencer in which the chance of the next trigger is set by the last three clocks, a state drawn as one of eight trigrams

params.text: The chance of a trigger on the next clock while the module is in that state, 0 for never and 1 for every clock

inputs.text: A rising edge above 3V draws the next trigger, at the chance set by the knob for the current state
A rising edge sets the state to that trigram; a clock arriving in the same sample is ignored

outputs.text: 10V when the clock three before the last one fired a trigger, 0V when it did not
10V when the clock before the last one fired a trigger, 0V when it did not
10V when the last clock fired a trigger, 0V when it did not
The chance set for the current state, scaled to 0-10V
A 1ms 10V pulse each time the sequencer fires

notes: the arrows on the panel show which states can follow which, a solid arrow for a clock that fired a trigger and a broken arrow for one that did not
Every probability knob comes up at zero, so no trigger is ever fired until one of them is raised
The state moves only on a rising edge at the clock input, so with nothing patched there the module holds the state it is in
